record_type_quote: This study replicates Hofstede’s study with data obtained from students studying for their master degrees in different universities in Jordan.

targets.evidence_quote: This study replicates Hofstede’s study with data obtained from students studying for their master degrees in different universities in Jordan.
targets.outcome_quote: In conclusion we argue that Hofstede’s (1980, 1991, 2005) assumption that people who grow up in the same place will share similar views about life does not apply to his findings about Arab cultures and thus his generalization made to Jordanian culture is not validated.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The overall conclusion rejects the generalization to Jordan, which decides the verdict despite agreement on some dimensions.

reasoning: New data re-test the cultural scores generalized to Jordan. The primary finding is attributed explicitly to Hofstede (1980), which is absent from the reference list; its title is therefore left empty. Later book editions summarize the same original dataset rather than constituting independent original studies. Parent cache inspected first; lacked provenance header and opening material, so the complete primary PDF was acquired and identity verified.
